day1_insight: Only a trace of rain has fallen recently (1.1 mm) — very little rain, and too little to drive meaningful runoff. The model's main signals right now: high tide timing is raising risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; only 1.1 mm of rain has fallen — very little rain, not enough to drive meaningful runoff; and high tide level is raising risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls. The most recent sample, 3 days ago, was over the limit at 640 MPN/100mL, and bacteria tend to linger from one sample to the next.
